# honeybadger_check_in (Resource)

A check-in monitor for a scheduled job. The job requests the check-in's report URL each time it runs, and Honeybadger alerts when a report doesn't arrive on schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "honeybadger_check_in" "nightly" {
  project_id    = honeybadger_project.app.id
  name          = "Nightly billing"
  report_period = "1 day"
  grace_period  = "10 minutes"
}

# The job pings this URL each time it finishes, for example with
# `curl -fsS "$CHECK_IN_URL"` at the end of the cron script.
output "nightly_check_in_url" {
  value = honeybadger_check_in.nightly.report_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project's `id`, as a project read returns it.

### Optional

- `cron_schedule` (String) Cron expression, required when `schedule_type` is `cron`.
- `cron_timezone` (String) Timezone the cron schedule is evaluated in. A Rails/ActiveSupport zone NAME, not an IANA identifier — `Central Time (US & Canada)`, not `America/Chicago`, which is rejected. Required when `schedule_type` is `cron`. Null resets it to `UTC`. Defaults to `UTC`.
- `grace_period` (String) How long after the expected time before the check-in is considered missing. Same format as `report_period`; zero is `00:00:00`. Null resets it to zero. Defaults to `00:00:00`.
- `name` (String) Display name. Null clears it; an unnamed check-in shows its ID.
- `report_period` (String) How often a report is expected, for `simple` schedules. Required unless `schedule_type` is `cron`, and may not be zero. A duration such as `5 minutes`, `1 hour 30 minutes` or `01:30:00`. Reads return the canonical long form (`1 week` reads `7 days`); every form a read returns can be written back. Compare periods by duration, not text.
- `schedule_type` (String) Switching to `simple` clears `cron_schedule` and resets `cron_timezone` to `UTC`; switching to `cron` clears `report_period`. Valid values: `simple`, `cron`. Defaults to `simple`.
- `slug` (String) Short identifier used in the check-in's reporting URL. Null clears it. Renaming it breaks jobs reporting to `…/check_in/<project key>/<slug>` and changes how `PUT /check_ins` matches this check-in.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the check-in was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier
- `report_url` (String) URL to ping when the task completes
